meta.title: Sigma Channel - Sigma CX
meta.description: The platform that integrates all customer touchpoints into a single solution.

opening: The platform that integrates all customer touchpoints into a *single solution*, combining *inbound and outbound* with *intelligence, security and scalability.*

intro.title: Sigma Channel
intro.body: Sigma Channel was developed to ensure a unique and consistent experience at every step of the journey, regardless of the channel you choose to interact.

tabs.label: Real-Time Monitoring
tabs.body: Track volumes, average service times, and service levels on dashboards that update every second.

tabs.label: Detailed Reports and Analysis
tabs.body: Identify opportunities for improvement with advanced reporting and analysis tools.

tabs.label: Omnichannel Campaigns
tabs.body: Deliver your message to your customer on the right channel at the right time, with automatic confirmations and targeted promotional campaigns.

flows.title: Customizable Flows
flows.body: Create and implement custom interaction flows to achieve your business objectives.

steps.title: Campaign
steps.body: Define the objective of the action.

steps.title: Channel
steps.body: Set up custom and scheduled shipments for each audience.

steps.title: Automated shooting
steps.body: Select where the campaign will be distributed (WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, etc).

steps.title: Engagement
steps.body: Monitor responses and interactions in real time.

steps.title: Dynamic Adjustments
steps.body: Optimize the flow during the campaign based on the results.

automate.title: Automate your customer's daily routine
automate.body: Sigma Channel automates everyday interactions, such as appointment reminders, purchase confirmations, and campaigns, strengthening customer contact and ensuring agility and proximity in every interaction.

items.title: Consistent experience
items.body: The agent receives and manages all interactions in one place.

items.title: Operational efficiency
items.body: Reduction of rework, centralization of management and automation of flows.

items.title: Personalization and proximity
items.body: Access to history, allowing for faster and more contextualized solutions.

actions.title: Smart actions for each stage of the relationship

items.title: Smart Reminders
items.body: Reduce missed appointments and increase punctuality with automatic notifications.

items.title: Purchase Confirmations
items.body: Reinforce customer trust with automatic confirmation messages.

items.title: Delivery Updates
items.body: Keep the customer informed at every stage of the order, in real time.

items.title: Payment Notices
items.body: Send personalized reminders that ensure convenience and reduce delays.

items.title: Cart Recovery
items.body: Re-engage customers with automatic reminders that encourage them to complete their purchase.

items.title: Proactive Campaigns
items.body: Create targeted and intelligent communications to increase engagement and loyalty.
